description: Implementation of polar coding algorithms, including generation of mother codes, interleavers, and code parameter setup for polar codes in a telecommunications context.

classes.name: polar_code_impl
classes.description: Class implementing polar coding algorithms, including code parameter setup, code generation, and interleaving for error correction.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Configures the polar code parameters such as K, E, nMax, and ibil, and prepares the code structure including frozen and information sets.

methods.name: get_n
methods.description: Returns the current code parameter n, related to code length.

methods.name: get_N
methods.description: Returns the total code length N.

methods.name: get_K
methods.description: Returns the number of information bits K.

methods.name: get_E
methods.description: Returns the rate-matched codeword length E.

methods.name: get_nPC
methods.description: Returns the number of parity check bits nPC.

methods.name: get_K_set
methods.description: Returns the set of reliable bit indices used for information and parity bits.

methods.name: get_PC_set
methods.description: Returns the set of parity check bit indices.

methods.name: get_F_set
methods.description: Returns the set of frozen bit indices.

methods.name: get_blk_interleaver
methods.description: Returns the block interleaver pattern for the current code configuration.

methods.name: get_ibil
methods.description: Returns the interleaving mode used in the code.
